verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows LiteLLM letting users version, review, or roll back their own automations, such as configs, routing rules, or workflows. The release-cycle and API-stability docs cover versioning of LiteLLM itself, not user automations, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. Fallbacks are runtime failover, not rollback of an automation definition.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
